The '''Jedi Enclave''' was located on [[Haashimut]], and run by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Till'in]] during the beginning of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The enclave was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] since [[24,000 BBY]], and was used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to keep a watchful eye on the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. The [[Haashimut caverns|nearby caverns]] of the planet were used during generations for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] meditation and for the training of the Enclave's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]].
